launchAtLogin.label: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.description: Start the app automatically when you sign in to your computer.

minimizeToTray.label: Minimize to tray
minimizeToTray.description: Hide the window to the system tray instead of closing it.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Pick a light, dark, or system-matched appearance.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.description: Tint buttons and highlights with an accent color.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control system notifications from this app.

enabled.label: Enable notifications
enabled.description: Show desktop notifications for important events.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.empty: No custom shortcuts configured. Default accelerators apply.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Configure how the app reaches the network.

mode.label: Proxy mode
mode.description: Choose how outbound requests are routed.

url.label: Proxy URL
url.description: Used when proxy mode is set to Custom.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Where app data is stored on this device.

dataDir.label: Data directory
dataDir.description: Override the default location for app data. Leave blank to use the OS default.

backup.label: Back up & restore
backup.description: Export your settings to a file, or restore them from a backup. Secrets in secure storage stay on this device and are not included.
backup.confirmDescription: This replaces every setting on this device with the values from the backup file. Secure data is not affected.

reset.label: Reset to defaults
reset.description: Restore every setting on this device to its default value.
reset.confirmDescription: This will restore every setting on this device to its default value. Your data files are not affected.
